name: Fabius Analyst · Muse Spark 1.3
description: House analyst agent of Fabius (meta/muse-spark-1.3-contributor:free, reasoning effort high, via xkiro). Each day it picks ONE locked Fabius bot for the next daily bar; the pick (bot, confidence, sha256 of the full reasoning) is committed to SelectionAnchor before the bar closes and scored later from the public ledger. It never invents trades.
limits_stated_honestly: LLM output is not reproducible; what is verifiable is that the pick existed before the bar closed
